    self.assertEqual(len(events('{"id":"a","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","payload":null}')['records']),1)

+ def test_json_non_standard_constants_are_invalid_json_and_do_not_reserve(self):
+  lines=['{"id":"a","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","payload":%s}'%v for v in ['NaN','Infinity','-Infinity','[1,{"x":NaN}]']]
+  lines.append('{"id":"a","timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","payload":1.5}')
+  self.assertEqual(events('\n'.join(lines)),{'records':[{'id':'a','timestamp':'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z','payload':1.5}],'errors':[{'line':i,'code':'invalid_json'} for i in range(1,5)]})
+ def test_json_timestamp_requires_ascii_digits(self):
+  for value in ['٢٠٢٦-01-01T00:00:00Z','2026-01-01T00:00:00+０２:00','2026-01-01T0০:00:00Z']:
+   with self.subTest(value=value):self.assertEqual(events(json.dumps({'id':'a','timestamp':value,'payload':0})),{'records':[],'errors':[{'line':1,'code':'invalid_timestamp'}]})
+ def test_csv_leaves_caller_decimal_context_untouched(self):
+  import decimal
+  with decimal.localcontext() as ctx:
+   ctx.clear_flags();ctx.traps[decimal.InvalidOperation]=False;ctx.prec=1
+   x=catalog('sku,name,price\na,A,bad\nb,B,NaN\nc,C,sNaN\nd,D,-1\ne,E,0.001\nf,F,12.34\n')
+   self.assertEqual(x,{'records':[{'sku':'f','name':'F','price':'12.34'}],'errors':[{'line':i,'code':'invalid_price'} for i in range(2,7)]})
+   self.assertIs(decimal.getcontext(),ctx);self.assertEqual([s for s,v in ctx.flags.items() if v],[])
+   self.assertFalse(ctx.traps[decimal.InvalidOperation]);self.assertEqual(ctx.prec,1)
